title: RoundStateSegment
description: One append-only segment of a round's durable state on the git bus (issue #86). Files live at .agents/rounds/<round>/<term>-<seq>-<writer>-<nonce>.json and are folded by (term, seq, at, writer). Parsed strictly by swarmly.telegram.rounds: an unknown field is ignored, a wrong type or an unknown version refuses the segment.

version.description: Schema version of this segment. A reader refuses a version it does not know.

repo.description: owner/name of the repository the round runs in (part of the bus directory name).

term.description: Coordinator term (#83). A segment from a lower term than the bus holds is refused.

seq.description: Monotone sequence within a term; ties are broken by writer so every reader folds identically.

writer.description: Alias of the bot that wrote the segment. Set by the transport, never by the model's text.

head.description: The head the block was written against; short verdict SHAs are expanded against it.

items.description: Item key (issue number) -> patch. Fields a patch does not mention keep their previous value in the fold.

order.description: Merge order for the round's items.

blockers.description: Why the round is not moving, one line each.

timers.description: Open WAKE timers (#81): timer id -> {owner, wake_id, until, check}.

note.description: One free-form line for people reading the bus.

base_seq.description: The seq the writer saw. Same term + same base_seq means two writes were concurrent; a shared field is then reported in conflicts, never silently resolved.

holder.description: The bot the store recorded as holding the round. Set by the transport: a block cannot claim it.

verdict.description: A verdict bound to the head it was given on. Reading it for another head yields nothing: a new head clears it.
